crossrefs.text: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my fatherʼs God, and I will exalt Him.
But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
Your sun will no longer set, and your moon will not wane; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your sorrow will cease.
O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.”
The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you!
I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
Let the wicked man forsake his own way and the unrighteous man his own thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
